title: Tools for Teaching & Learning
copy: My Museum Tour. Curate a group of artworks related to your teaching goals for your students to explore. JourneyMaker. Create your own one-of-a-kind activity-filled art adventure for younger learners and elementary schoolers. Featured Content. Browse these resource highlights. Ask an Educator. Art Institute educators can provide custom recommendations to support your self-guided museum experience or in-class teaching. Tell us more about your interests and needs, and we’ll follow up with suggestions on specific artworks from the museum’s global collection and digital resources you might want to use. Student-Facing Activities. Pair these student activities with your choice of artworks to encourage critical and creative thinking. Teen Audio Guide. Experience the museum through sounds and stories produced by Chicago teens. Media. Engage with these resources for quick and informative dives into artworks and the museum field. Spotlight: Black Art and History. Explore the work of Black artists and related resources from the museum's collections, that span time, geography, and artistic media.
